parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host where the control policy to be deleted resides.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description:
The ID of the control policy to be deleted.
> You can call the [ListPolicies](~~2758876~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
